dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular and crenellated high-contrast white boundaries forming interlocking 'O' and 'C' shapes. The perimeters exhibit a sharp gradient transition from the dark charcoal exterior to a medium-grey interior, with the most prominent rings located on the anterior and mid-dorsal regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Sparse spatial density of solid high-intensity white punctate spots; isolated dots are visible on the upper anterior region and near the base of the tail, lacking internal gradients or complex internal structure.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli in the mid-body region form an elongated, obtuse scalene triangle with the longest side oriented parallel to the dorsal-ventral axis.
